messages.subject: Error in cat(list(...), file, sep, fill, labels, append) :
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to create a shiny app that has two data manipulation filter.  One for channel and one that finds a word within a string of text and returns all matching values.  Below is an example of my code that is giving me an error;

Server.R
shinyServer(
  function(input, output) {
    data <- reactive({
      if (input$selection == 'All') {
        if(input$drill==""){
          survey_data
        } else {
          drill <- survey_data
          drill <- grepl(input$drill, drill$Misc_Text_Feedback, value = TRUE)
        } 
      } else {
        if(input$drill==""){
          subset(survey_data, survey_data$Supply_Channel == input$selection )
        } else {
          drill <- subset(survey_data, survey_data$Supply_Channel == input$selection)
          drill <- grepl(input$drill, drill$Misc_Text_Feedback)
        } 
      } 
    })

However, everytime I run this piece of code I am getting the following error;

Error in cat(list(...), file, sep, fill, labels, append) : 
  argument 1 (type 'list') cannot be handled by 'cat'

I am not sure how to handle this error or where it is coming from, I am wondering if there is an easier way to do the above or if someone can help me understand what the problem is.

Thanks so much in advance for your help and let me know if there is more context I can provide.  The UI.r corresponding is listed below;

fluidPage(
 
  titlePanel("Groupon Word Cloud"),
  
  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(    inputId   = "selection", 
                      label     = "Choose a Supply Channel",
                      choices   = c('All',
                                  'Channel 1',
                                  'Channel 2',
                                  'Channel 3',
                                  'Channel 4,'),        
                      selected  = 'All'),
      hr(),
      textInput(      inputId   = "exclude", 
                      label     = "Exclude a word"),
      textInput(      inputId   = "drill", 
                      label     = "Drill down into a word"),
      submitButton(   text      = "Update")
